ap_diplomatic_desc_key.en: With the incorporation of [target_location.GetName] into the [scope:winner.GetFlavorRank] of [scope:winner.GetName],

ap_falls_desc_key.en: After a turbulent siege and a valiant defense of the resident garrison, [target_location.GetName] has fallen to the might of our great armies. Within its walls resides a powerful religious authority, as the [target_location.GetRank.GetNameWithNoTooltip] once hosted dignitaries of the [ShowReligionAdjective('orthodox')] faith. The question remains yet, should we abolish this kindred institution or adopt it under our protection?
ap_falls_desc_key.uk: Після тривалої облоги оборону відважного гарнізону було зламано, і [target_location.GetRank.GetNameWithNoTooltip|l] [target_location.GetName] впав перед нашими могутніми арміями. Усередині стін міста знаходиться впливова релігійна організація: раніше тут засідали верховні #TOOLTIP:RELIGION,$orthodox_tt$,X #L православні#!#! служителі. Чи варто нам скасувати цей братський інститут чи прийняти його під своє покровительство?

ap_falls_desc_key_2.en: Within its walls resides a powerful religious authority, as the [target_location.GetRank.GetNameWithNoTooltip] once hosted dignitaries of the [ShowReligionAdjective('orthodox')] faith. The question remains yet, should we abolish this kindred institution or adopt it under our protection?

autocephalous_patriarchates.1.c.en: Now we will be the ones to deal with the Patriarch.

autocephalous_patriarchates.1.desc.en: $ap_falls_desc_key$ It was the seat of the [target_ap.GetName], and now it comes to us to decide what to do with this Patriarchal authority.

autocephalous_patriarchates.1.desc_diplo.en: $ap_diplomatic_desc_key$ the seat of the [target_ap.GetName] now falls under our authority. It comes to us to decide what to do with this Patriarchal institution.

autocephalous_patriarchates.2.desc_diplo.en: $ap_diplomatic_desc_key$ it comes to us to decide upon matters of its faith. $ap_falls_desc_key_2$

autocephalous_patriarchates.3.desc.en: With the relocation of the [recipient.GetName] to [target_location.GetName], the glory of the [target.GetType.GetName] has been restored. From now on, the Patriarchate will lead the matters of the faith with the majesty and reverence that befits such lofty seat.

every_member_of_scopeloser_ap_loses_opin.en: Every member of the [target_ap.GetName] will lose [ShowBiasValue('destroyed_my_autocephalous_patriarchate')|+=0] opinion of us
every_member_of_scopeloser_ap_loses_opin.uk: Усі члени патріархату «[target_ap.GetName]» змінять свою думку про нас на [ShowBiasValue('destroyed_my_autocephalous_patriarchate')|-=0]

every_member_of_winner_ap_gains_opinion_.en: Every member of the [target_winner_ap.GetName] will gain [ShowBiasValue('destroyed_another_autocephalous_patriarchate')|+=0] opinion of us
